flags.where: Student sample response (A): 'the man on the right who is inking the type with two ink balls while a large wooden screw press stands next to him'
flags.detail: In Jost Amman's 1568 woodcut 'Der Buchdrucker' (Ständebuch, Frankfurt am Main), the pressman holding the two ink balls stands on the LEFT of the foreground; the screw press is in the center, the second pressman handling the paper sheet is at the right, and the compositors at their type cases are in the background. The sample misplaces the inker on the right. The remainder of the description (hand inking, forme, press, repeated copies) is accurate.
